images.title: 4000 grouped into powers of 60
images.purpose: Shows 4000 grouped as one 3600, six 60s and 40 ones.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. The number at the top and three boxes in a row beneath it, each box headed by its landmark and holding a count.
images.exact_structure: Top centre: 4000 in large dark text. Below it, three equal rounded boxes in a row with dark outlines. Above the boxes, small grey (#6B7280) landmark headers left to right: 3600s, 60s, 1s. Inside the boxes, large teal (#0072B2) counts left to right: 1, 6, 40. Exactly 3 boxes. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: In base 60 the landmarks are 1, 60, 3600: 4000 is one 3600, six 60s and 40.
images.description: Shows 4000 grouped as one 3600, six 60s and 40 ones.

image_decisions.why: Three boxes make the grouping into powers of 60 easy to check.
